intro: One day we were having an English class when

lines.text: Mr. Black see a boy reading a picture book and said,
lines.reason: 整篇在叙述过去的英语课，与said并列的see应为过去式saw。

lines.text: "Tom, how do you usually do after lunch?" Tom
lines.reason: 问午饭后通常做什么，do后缺宾语，用what；how问做事方式。

lines.text: got up nervous from his seat. He did not know how
lines.reason: 修饰got up这一动作需要副词nervously，表示紧张地起身。

lines.text: to answer it. He thought for while and said,
lines.reason: for a while是“一会儿”的固定短语，while前不能省a。

lines.text: "Wait for supper." The teacher is unhappy, and
lines.reason: 当时老师不高兴，叙述过去用was，与上下文过去时保持一致。

lines.text: at that moments he saw Rose sleeping. He was angry
lines.reason: at that moment表示在那个时刻，that后接单数moment。

lines.text: but he tried not to show for it. Then he asked, "And you,
lines.reason: show为及物动词，show it表示流露情绪，it前无需for。

lines.text: Rose?" Rose woke up but did not hear the question. She
lines.reason: woke up与did not hear均为过去时，叙述Rose醒来却未听到问题，结构正确。

lines.text: asked hers desk-mate, who dared not say anything. Then
lines.reason: desk-mate前要形容词性物主代词her；hers不能直接修饰名词。

lines.text: Rose stood up and replied in a loudly voice,
lines.reason: voice是名词，前用形容词loud；loudly为副词。
